The main takeaway from our work is that
the TriPlex platform enables the design of ultra compact photonic chips with a fully integrated laser and detectors that are compatible with standard CMOS processes.

we show that the TriPlex platform is suitable for the design of ultra compact photonic chips that are fully integrated with the laser source and photodetectors and that are compatible with the flip chip bonding technique.

we show how to design the grating couplers on the silicon nitride TriPleX photonic platform for coupling light from a flip chip bonded laser and how to design the MMI couplers for the splitting of the optical power among multiple MRRs.
